records.context: The overlaps are feathered by default: each microscope image field is weighted by how far a pixel lies from that microscope image field's nearest edge, so a microscope image field fades out where its neighbour fades in and no seam is left where two microscope image fields disagree in brightness. Plain averaging (``blend='average'``) gives a noise gain of about 1.15x in the raster's 14% overlap but keeps a brightness step at each microscope image field edge; on Funk et al. 2022 the feathered seams scored like a single unstitched microscope image field cut at the same place, and the averaged ones did not (:func:`compose_window`).
records.label: spacr.ops_compose#3
records.source: The overlaps are feathered by default: each tile is weighted by how far a pixel lies from that tile's nearest edge, so a tile fades out where its neighbour fades in and no seam is left where two tiles disagree in brightness. Plain averaging (``blend='average'``) gives a noise gain of about 1.15x in the raster's 14% overlap but keeps a brightness step at each tile edge; on Funk et al. 2022 the feathered seams scored like a single unstitched tile cut at the same place, and the averaged ones did not (:func:`compose_window`).
records.translation: Los solapamientos se difuminan por defecto: cada tesela se pondera según la distancia de un píxel al borde más cercano de esa tesela, de modo que una tesela se desvanece donde su vecina aparece y no queda ninguna costura donde dos teselas difieren en brillo. El promedio simple (``blend='average'``) da una ganancia de ruido de aproximadamente 1.15x en el 14% de solapamiento del barrido, pero mantiene un escalón de brillo en cada borde de tesela; en Funk et al. 2022 las costuras difuminadas puntuaron como una sola tesela sin unir cortada en el mismo lugar, y las promediadas no (:func:`compose_window`).

records.source: ``(image, coverage)`` -- the blended window and how many tiles contributed to each pixel. Coverage is returned because a pixel no tile reached is not a black pixel, and only the count tells them apart. It is the same count for either blend.
records.translation: ``(image, coverage)`` -- la ventana fusionada y cuántas teselas contribuyeron a cada píxel. La cobertura se devuelve porque un píxel al que no llegó ninguna tesela no es un píxel negro, y solo el recuento permite distinguirlos. Es el mismo recuento con cualquiera de los dos modos de fusión.

records.translation: para una ventana vacía, una tesela que no es un solo plano o un ``blend`` desconocido.

records.context: Feathered by default. Each microscope image field's pixel is weighted by its distance, in pixels, to the nearest edge of that microscope image field, plus one, and the composite is ``sum(weight x tile) / sum(weight)``. A microscope image field's edge pixels weigh 1 and its pixels deep in the overlap weigh more, so each microscope image field fades out where its neighbour fades in. A plain average weighs both microscope image fields equally across the whole overlap and so keeps a step where one microscope image field ends: the edge of the overlap is where the composite switches from the mean of two microscope image fields to one microscope image field. On Funk et al. 2022 (DAPI, cycle 1; well A1 of laboratory microplates A and B, then well B2 of held-out laboratory microplates C and D) the share of feathered seams that step more than the microscope image field centres matched that of a single unstitched microscope image field cut at exactly the same place, within 1 point (95 % CI); the averaged seams' share was 11 to 12 points higher on C and D. No flat-microscope field of view or gain correction is applied: feathering alone passed and was the fastest arm that did. Where one microscope image field covers a pixel the weights cancel and the pixel is that microscope image field's value. The feathered sums are kept in float64, where products of 16-bit values and weights of several hundred are exact.
records.label: spacr.ops_compose.compose_window#2
records.source: FEATHERED BY DEFAULT. Each tile's pixel is weighted by its distance, in pixels, to the nearest edge of that tile, plus one, and the composite is ``sum(weight x tile) / sum(weight)``. A tile's edge pixels weigh 1 and its pixels deep in the overlap weigh more, so each tile fades out where its neighbour fades in. A plain average weighs both tiles equally across the whole overlap and so keeps a step where one tile ends: the edge of the overlap is where the composite switches from the mean of two tiles to one tile. On Funk et al. 2022 (DAPI, cycle 1; well A1 of plates A and B, then well B2 of held-out plates C and D) the share of feathered seams that step more than the tile centres matched that of a single unstitched tile cut at exactly the same place, within 1 point (95 % CI); the averaged seams' share was 11 to 12 points higher on C and D. No flat-field or gain correction is applied: feathering alone passed and was the fastest arm that did. Where one tile covers a pixel the weights cancel and the pixel is that tile's value. The feathered sums are kept in float64, where products of 16-bit values and weights of several hundred are exact.
records.translation: DIFUMINADO POR DEFECTO. Cada píxel de una tesela se pondera por su distancia, en píxeles, al borde más cercano de esa tesela, más uno, y el compuesto es ``sum(weight x tile) / sum(weight)``. Los píxeles del borde de una tesela pesan 1 y sus píxeles situados en el interior del solapamiento pesan más, de modo que cada tesela se desvanece donde su vecina aparece. Un promedio simple pondera ambas teselas por igual en todo el solapamiento y por eso mantiene un escalón donde termina una tesela: el borde del solapamiento es donde el compuesto pasa de la media de dos teselas a una sola tesela. En Funk et al. 2022 (DAPI, ciclo 1; pocillo A1 de las placas A y B, y después pocillo B2 de las placas reservadas C y D) la proporción de costuras difuminadas con un escalón mayor que el de los centros de las teselas coincidió con la de una sola tesela sin unir cortada exactamente en el mismo lugar, con una diferencia de menos de 1 punto (IC 95 %); la proporción de las costuras promediadas fue de 11 a 12 puntos más alta en C y D. No se aplica ninguna corrección de campo plano ni de ganancia: el difuminado por sí solo superó la prueba y fue la variante más rápida que lo hizo. Donde una sola tesela cubre un píxel, los pesos se cancelan y el píxel toma el valor de esa tesela. Las sumas difuminadas se guardan en float64, donde los productos de valores de 16 bits y pesos de varios cientos son exactos.

records.context: ``blend='average'`` gives the earlier plain mean, unchanged. It has the larger noise gain in the overlaps (about 1.15x, :func:`overlap_gain`); feathering gives up some of it near the microscope image field edges for the seam.

records.source: ``blend='average'`` gives the earlier plain mean, unchanged. It has the larger noise gain in the overlaps (about 1.15x, :func:`overlap_gain`); feathering gives up some of it near the tile edges for the seam.
records.translation: ``blend='average'`` da la media simple anterior, sin cambios. Tiene la mayor ganancia de ruido en los solapamientos (aproximadamente 1.15x, :func:`overlap_gain`); el difuminado renuncia a parte de ella cerca de los bordes de las teselas a cambio de eliminar la costura.
